data.message: Fisher15: I commit to 18 tons and invite each of the other 24 to opt in individually, not all-or-nothing. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). Even all18 leaves50, but recovery isn't guaranteed; long-run gains aren't assured. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. Each person: state your exact intended catch and whether it depends on others.
